sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 33 (quality check 32), Internal Quality Checks row 33 including annotations (no additional nonempty annotation/comment for row 32); both populated quality/deterministic sheets read
evidence: Reviewed all 156 criterion descriptions (145 Functional, 4 Polish, 5 Visual, 2 gates) against actual workbook Quality Checks/Internal Quality Checks row 33 and skill reference lines 134-136. No row-32 instance found. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:3 restricts evidence to rendered UI and ordinary product traffic and prohibits implementation/source/database inspection; :13 requires unique per-session records and permits generated IDs, alternate routes and money representations; :17 explicitly says direct API success does not satisfy a UI-creation requirement; :19 requires before/after facts. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25 requires the actual created requisition and offer, association and values in an independent empty browser context; a static seed response or no-op message is expressly insufficient. Functional descriptions identify distinguishable inputs/results: odd-cent composition and band boundaries, named actor/tier cells, fresh saved lineage and economic rows, stale versus current state, overlapping versus disjoint transactions, and original receipts after later actions/restart. Rejections compare persisted state against before-values. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:785 grades only the explicitly public anonymous 401 policy, following a populated authenticated control; this is an observable access outcome, not a invented response schema being substituted for a mutation. The public basis is .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md:369-371. Confidentiality and write effects have their own observations. .qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r2/task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23,32,41,50 specify retained distinct inputs and successful correction/retry; the uncertain-commit case forwards a real operation and suppresses only its response, then observes the same saved operation. Visual criteria give five observable anchors for typography, contrast, layout, hierarchy and component consistency across multiple named surfaces; they do not reduce to an unanchored looks-right instruction. Raw evidence index SHA256 1ef29f836bb775ef2ed19fc158bee979aef4d43ead0578fdb13fe9bacb6daad1 had 292 entries when inspected; every current artifact hash matched. I read the batch-domain driver/results and independently matched its four recorded application-source hashes to this frozen task. The driver compares financial before/after data, records actual operation/receipt identities and re-reads after restart; the audit-history driver checks a newly created approval line after 5,050 later logins and through a fresh Auditor browser UI. Batch results SHA256 a44c0bf81b27981d9bf1d63239f8b7ce7da5733d6d70aef425e2350a76b7732f; audit results SHA256 40221757ac15433039e2236580baaabae5443b55755606fe93e99f3653c44a50. These support finite observability, not complete criterion execution. This Pass is the row-32 semantic judgment. Full configured judge completion, workload, score discrimination, private deterministic-checker execution and portal/Oracle/model scores remain unmeasured; their separate required runtime evidence is not waived. No new Docker/provider run was performed.
counterexample: Plausible broken app challenged: a UI accepts every action, displays the expected success/receipt, and only updates browser memory. It could satisfy response-only tests but fails the independently signed-in requisition/offer readback and saved-state/receipt comparisons specified here. A write handler returning 403 after changing state similarly fails the required fresh unchanged-state readback. Conforming alternative challenged: generated UUIDs, a shared authenticated bootstrap endpoint, dollar-string money, equivalent UTC date rendering, cards instead of tables, and a retained read-only rescission confirmation with Retry. The gate/functional prompt explicitly allow alternate routes, schemas, IDs, representations and layouts; Polish line 32 explicitly accepts the confirmation design. No concrete false failure attributable to row 32 was found.
